title: Sender With Largest Word Count
summary: Given a chat log with messages and their senders, determine the sender with the highest total word count.
statement: Given a chat log with messages and their senders, determine the sender with the highest total word count. If multiple senders have the same count, choose the one with the lexicographically largest name. Uppercase letters precede lowercase letters in lexicographical order.
constraints: messages[i] was sent by senders[i], and words are separated by single spaces.
Sum word counts across all messages from each sender.
Choose the lexicographically largest sender name when total counts tie.
hints: Aggregate word totals in a dictionary keyed by sender.
Python tuple ordering can rank first by total and then by sender name.
Aggregation computes each sender’s exact total, and the tuple key implements both primary and tie-break rules.
editorial: Aggregation computes each sender’s exact total, and the tuple key implements both primary and tie-break rules.

tests.explanation: Alice has five total words, more than either other sender.
Both senders have five words, so lexicographically larger Charlie wins.
